result.summary: The image depicts a wide residential street with sidewalks but a complete absence of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible intersection. The broad roadway width and lack of traffic calming measures create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated or protected space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Exposure
hazards.description: The excessive width of the main road increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic and likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the main asphalt roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a residential corner with sidewalks but no marked crosswalks or curb ramps. A large tree at the corner and parked vehicles create significant visual obstructions for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree at the corner and parked cars block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps makes crossing difficult and inaccessible.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warnings at the corner.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the corner to improve visibility for all road users.
